prompt: In the style of cinematic film still, the scene unfolds in a misty village market at dawn where soft gray light filters through the air. On the far left stands an old woman in a blue shawl holding a woven basket tightly against her chest. Next to her sits a young boy in a striped shirt tying his shoelaces with focused intensity. A brown dog rests its head on the boy's knee, watching the surroundings with half-closed eyes. In the center foreground, a man in a red scarf gestures toward a pile of bright orange pumpkins stacked neatly on a wooden crate. Beside him, a girl in a yellow dress points at the largest pumpkin, her finger extended clearly. Behind them, a vendor in a green apron hands a small paper bag to a customer in a black coat who reaches out with both hands. To the right of the vendor, a white cat perches atop a stack of empty crates, grooming its paw meticulously. Near the cat, a teenager in a denim jacket leans against a stone pillar, looking at a smartphone held in one hand. Further back on the right, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a low stool, sipping from a steaming ceramic mug. A bicycle with a wicker basket is parked next to the seated man, its kickstand firmly planted in the dirt. In the background left, two children in matching raincoats run past a stall displaying hanging bunches of dried herbs. One child looks back while the other holds a bright red apple. A large rooster with iridescent feathers stands near the herb stall, pecking at scattered grains on the ground. Above the scene, strings of colorful flags flutter gently in the breeze, attached to wooden poles on either side of the path. A lantern hangs from one pole, unlit but visible against the brightening sky. A wooden signboard leans against a wall in the distance, its text obscured by shadow. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the frame. There is no plastic packaging used for any of the goods. There is no electronic equipment other than the single smartphone.
